venue.name: BC Archives
venue.description: The BC Archives is the provincial archive of British Columbia, at 675 Belleville Street in Victoria beside the Royal BC Museum. Research is done in a reference room where visitors search catalogues and finding aids, read microfilm and request original records, and everyone doing archival research must register with photo identification. The Archives also says its staff provide tours of the facility and develop workshops about its collections, and that it creates exhibitions in the Royal BC Museum and Archives' gallery spaces. In late 2026 the BC Archives will be moving to the new PARC Campus in Colwood.
restrictions: To register, persons must be at least 16 years old and must present photo identification at the time of registration.
Children under the age of 16 must be accompanied by a registered parent or guardian who will be responsible for the child during the entire visit.
All persons arriving at the BC Archives to perform archival research must register before being admitted to the reference room.
Leave coats, hats, briefcases, parcels, laptop cases, purses and fanny packs in the lobby. There is a coat rack and lockers are provided at no charge.
Eating, chewing gum, and drinking are prohibited in the Reference Room, and there are no public smoking areas in the building.
Use only pencils to take notes. Do not use ink in any form in the Reference Room.
Refrain from wearing fragrances or other scents.
Cameras are permitted but without the use of a flash.
Keep conversations with fellow researchers to a minimum and speak quietly.
venue.hours_notes: Monday 10am–6pm (partial service); Tuesday to Friday 10am–4pm with partial service 12pm–1pm and 4pm–6pm; Saturday 10am–4pm (partial service); Sunday closed. No retrieval of archival material or staffed assistance from 12 noon–1pm daily. 'Partial Service' means no reference archivist is on duty and books or records cannot be retrieved on the spot. 2026 closure dates: January 1, February 16, April 3, April 6, May 18, July 1, August 3, September 7, September 30, October 12, November 11, December 25, December 28.
venue.seasonal_notes: In late 2026, the BC Archives will be moving to the new PARC Campus in Colwood, BC, with changes to location and service levels and temporary closures.

programs.name: Facility tour or workshop
programs.description: The Access & Outreach page states that staff provide tours of the facility and develop workshops teaching people about the collections, how to use the BC Archives and a variety of research topics, and that the Archives takes part in community events across British Columbia. No age range, price, length, capacity, schedule, lead time or booking route is published for these tours and workshops; the page directs all questions to Contact Us.
programs.our_note: Nothing on this site is built for children: everyone using the reference room registers at 16 or over with photo ID, and under-16s must be with a registered parent or guardian for the whole visit. If a facility tour still appeals, phone the reference desk first and ask what ages they take, what it costs and whether the late-2026 move to Colwood affects your date.
programs.practical_summary: The address, hours and reference room rules are published — no food, drink or pens, quiet voices, and free lockers and a coat rack in the lobby. Price, ages, capacity, washrooms, lunch space and wheelchair access are all unstated, and the Archives moves to Colwood in late 2026.
programs.evidence: Staff provide tours of our facility and develop workshops to teach people about our collections
